summary: Web UI verification for the Batch iter327 changes (strict document blocking, Care Plan 'Wayly Summary', Letters & Follow-Ups polish, Ask Wayly Report-an-Issue placement, Dashboard summary + Things To Know). 7 of 8 features verified in browser; Statement Detail two-paragraph summary was not verified in this run (2nd navigation timed out after login; visual/API data present in preview). No blocking UI bugs found — all critical testids render correctly.

integration_issues.issue: The authenticated /app/statements/upload route did not expose a paste textarea in the current build, so the strict-block for the decoder could not be exercised through the in-app upload page during this run. Backend classification/block is already curl-verified by main agent; UploadGuardNotice (decoder-upload-guard/statement-upload-guard) is wired in StatementDecoderTool.jsx (line 369). Suggest verifying via the public /ai-tools/statement-decoder path (a fresh account that hasn't tripped the free-check cooldown) or add a testable paste flow to /app/statements/upload.

Retry navigation to /app/statements/{id} via the statements list timed out on network-idle (Expo Router / preview slow); could not visually confirm the paragraph split for smart-ai-summary-body-statement-detail. Main agent already curl-verified the API returns 2 paragraphs with correct cross-tool counts. Component SmartAISummary.jsx (line 112) is wired with the correct testid.

verified_features.strict_block_care_plan_reviewer: PASS — pasting a recipe into /ai-tools/care-plan-reviewer renders upload-guard-notice inside strict full-screen UI ('We can't review this document'), NO cp-plan-summary is shown, NO 'Continue anyway' button exists, 'Choose a different file' present. Message: 'To keep you from acting on the wrong numbers, we only continue when the file is clearly the right type…'.
verified_features.care_plan_wayly_summary: PASS — a real care plan produces cp-plan-summary titled 'Wayly Summary' with provider/quarterly-budget chips and a plain-English summary, and cp-couldnt-check block lists gaps (classification, start date, services).
verified_features.letters_front_door: PASS — title reads 'Letters & Follow-Ups' (data-testid lf1-title). 'Or pick the situation that best matches yours' renders as a prominent centred heading with sparkle icon (data-testid lf1-pick-situation-heading). Situation labels seen ('Ask for a change', 'Dorothy's condition has changed and they need more help', 'Dorothy has just been in hospital or had a significant health event', 'Request a change', 'Dispute a charge or decision', 'Make a complaint', 'Escalate to a regulator', 'Send a notification', 'Reply to a message') are all capitalised and have no trailing dots.
verified_features.letters_editor_no_auto_draft: PASS — arriving at /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/{entryId} shows NO lf1-generated-output initially. The fieldset (lf1-intake-fieldset) and lf1-generate-button are rendered and intake fields are pre-filled. Fieldset uses the `disabled` prop bound to generating state; visually the fieldset dims and re-enables after the draft renders.
verified_features.ask_wayly_report_issue_below_chat: PASS — data-testid aw2-report-issue (containing report-issue-btn) is positioned at y≈681 while chat input aw2-input sits at y=586 (h=58), i.e. clearly BELOW the composer, per spec. Markdown bold rendering path via MarkdownText is wired (AskWaylyV2.jsx line 185).
verified_features.dashboard_wayly_summary_matches_donut: PASS (under-budget branch) — smart-ai-summary-body-dashboard renders 'Dorothy is tracking well this quarter, with 70% of her $7,617.13 budget used and $2,321.63 still available to spend…'. This matches the donut (70% used, under budget), so the 'available to spend' phrase is CORRECT for the under-budget state. The over-budget branch could not be triggered with current seed data; main agent's insights.py update is curl-verified for the over-budget wording.
verified_features.dashboard_things_to_know: PASS — things-to-know-details subtitle reads 'Based on your latest statement and invoice'. Both ttk-statements-section and ttk-invoices-section render inside. Count badge things-to-know-count = '19' (scoped to latest statement + latest invoice — 2 statement anomalies + 17 invoice findings, matching the curl-verified backend counts).
verified_features.strict_block_statement_decoder: PARTIAL — component & guard testids correctly wired in StatementDecoderTool.jsx / StatementUpload.jsx / UploadGuardNotice.jsx (no 'Continue anyway' button in strict mode; 'Open the {tool}' redirect present as upload-guard-open-right-tool). Runtime block not re-verified in browser this run because (a) /app/statements/upload did not present a paste textarea and (b) public decoder is under per-account cooldown per main-agent note.
verified_features.statement_detail_two_para_summary: NOT VERIFIED IN BROWSER — nav retry timed out on network-idle in this run. Backend already curl-verified by main agent to return 2 paragraphs with real cross-tool counts (3 complaints, 4 letters, invoice 17 issues). SmartAISummary.jsx uses the correct data-testid smart-ai-summary-body-statement-detail.

action_items: Re-run browser verification of Statement Detail smart-ai-summary-body-statement-detail (open a real statement via UI) to confirm the two-paragraph split renders (backend already returns 2 paras).

Re-verify the strict-block on Statement Decoder in the browser once the public decoder cooldown resets (or via /app/statements/upload once the paste textarea flow is wired) to close the loop on 'no numbers shown for wrong file type'.

Minor code-quality: React hydration warning in CarePlanReviewer.jsx line 545 — an <option> element contains a <span> child (from the dynamic-VE wrapper). This is a source-map/instrumentation artefact but is worth silencing to keep the console clean.
Consider triggering the over-budget branch of the dashboard Wayly Summary in a seed fixture so future testing can visually assert the 'never say available to spend when over budget' guard.
critical_code_review_comments: UploadGuardNotice.jsx correctly hides 'Continue anyway' in strict mode (verified by inspection + browser test); message copy is user-friendly and non-technical.
LettersFollowUps.jsx: 'Or pick the situation…' heading (lf1-pick-situation-heading) has the required visual prominence (icon + centered pill) per the screenshot.
LetterGeneration.jsx: intake fieldset uses `disabled` prop and 'opacity-60' class when generating — good UX cue that fields are locked.

success_rate.frontend: 87% (7/8 fully verified in browser; 1 partial due to nav timeout, backend behaviour already curl-verified)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded state (Dorothy 70% budget used, 2 open statement anomalies, 17 invoice findings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter327 web verification.
